g.text: How we modernise legacy with legaseeder
- scope: entry points or whole system
- links the legacy code, never modifies it
- 5 questions only a human can answer
- size, tech debt, CWE security findings
scout + critic (what did the scout miss?)
- new entry point -> re-run, done units stay
- CM rule extraction, only on scope modules
- every rule re-verified by a 2nd agent
- bound to units; P0 rule -> critical unit
- one fresh agent per unit, clean context
- every agent writes only its own file
- writes the unit from its own sources only
- done only if writer status + checker PASS
+ mech check (+ judge PASS if critical)
- previous errors go into the work order
assessment ends here, rebuild is Code Modernization territory
- phased plan, approved by a human
- input: legaseeder spec + CM rule cards
- old vs new: same input -> same output
